categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of processed cheese and bakery ingredients. Its main product categories include cheese products such as mozzarella and shredded cheese (64.1% of sales) and food additives including pizza sauce, meal kits, and fresh yeast (35.9%). It also engages in frozen pizza production and other processed food items.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced food processing technologies including cheese processing, baking ingredient formulation, and frozen food manufacturing. It holds multiple HACCP certifications for natural cheese, bakery products, sauces, and ready-to-eat meals, indicating rigorous food safety and quality control systems. Production facilities utilize modern manufacturing lines for shredded and processed cheese, with continuous R&D focused on taste improvement and productivity enhancement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include franchise chains, large supermarkets, department stores, bakeries, and coffee shops across South Korea. The company targets the foodservice industry and retail sectors, catering to evolving consumer preferences for premium and diverse cheese and bakery products. Export activities are limited but include certifications for markets such as China, Japan, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with production plants located in Ansan, Daeso, and Gimcheon. It has domestic sales offices and a distribution network serving nationwide customers. Export efforts are ongoing but currently represent a small portion of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the food supply chain, focusing on manufacturing processed cheese, bakery ingredients, and related food additives. It sources raw materials both domestically and internationally and supplies finished products directly to manufacturers and wholesalers in the food industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding sales through active marketing of cheese products and developing new convenient meal solutions. R&D efforts focus on fundamental taste research, productivity improvements, and product diversification, including regional specialty cheese products. The company invests steadily in research and development, allocating over 0.6% of sales to R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of processed cheese, bakery ingredients, and food additives. The company sells directly to manufacturers and wholesalers, with payment terms typically monthly cash or three-month promissory notes. Additional minor revenue streams include rental income from real estate holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition in the processed cheese and frozen pizza markets from other food manufacturers offering similar products. It maintains a competitive position by focusing on product quality, HACCP certifications, and expanding its product portfolio to meet changing consumer tastes. The company is recognized as a mid-sized player with growing market share in the domestic cheese and bakery ingredient sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 406 billion KRW, reflecting a 25.3% increase from the previous year. Operating profit grew modestly by 4.5%, while net profit declined significantly due to increased raw material costs and higher interest expenses. Total assets stood at about 394 billion KRW with a debt ratio of 163.3%, indicating moderate leverage and ongoing efforts to improve financial structure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, fresh, and premium cheese and bakery ingredients tailored to modern consumer preferences for diverse and sophisticated tastes. It differentiates through rigorous food safety certifications, continuous product innovation, and responsiveness to market trends such as convenience foods and regional specialty products. Its integrated production and R&D capabilities support stable supply and product excellence.
